verdict: Organic engagement is softening across all three brands this week.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all engagement across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals came entirely from Google Business Profiles — paid advertising recorded $0 spend and zero leads across every entity. Combined GBP activity totaled 420 actions (directions, web clicks, and calls), but the most recent 7 days show a pullback: O'Hare down 58%, Forte down 50%, while Advance Grinding bucked the trend with a 25% week-over-week gain. Organic search visibility is softening simultaneously, with Search Console clicks declining 57% at Forte and 31% at O'Hare over the same 7-day window. Site reindexing and SEO root-cause work are in motion targeting recovery by end of October, and outreach sequences are being prepared to open a demand channel that does not depend on search alone.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three brands in the last 28 days
drop in O'Hare GBP engagement over the past 7 days, the sharpest weekly decline this period
Search Console clicks recorded at Advance Grinding this period, the strongest organic search performance of the three brands

watch_item.issue: Organic search visibility declining across Forte and O'Hare, with Search Console clicks down materially week-over-week and two GBP profiles at O'Hare showing zero calls despite active impressions.
watch_item.fix: Site reindexing is underway and an SEO root-cause fix is being submitted this month; GBP profile categories are being reviewed to address the call conversion gap.
